assumptions.generator: CubeMars GL60 KV25 (manufacturer values per the 31 Oct 2026 review citation; pages not reachable from this session)
assumptions.Kt_note: Kt = 60/(2 pi 21.5) = 0.444 N m/A (energy-consistent); the page also quotes 0.45 (0.40 on one reseller)
assumptions.rectifier: 6x MBR10100 (100 V Schottky), Vf ~0.55 V at 1-2 A (estimate)
assumptions.friction_note: PTFE lip seal (Varilip PDR / Dichta) 15 mm: ~half of an NBR seal: 7.5 mN m running, 15 breakaway (assumed; no measured value exists); NBR alternative 15 / 30 mN m; cogging 24 mN m inferred for the GL60 (II lists 2.4 cN m)
assumptions.iron_note: no-load (iron + bearing-seal) loss of the GL60 is not published; 1.0 W at 700 rpm scaling with rpm^1.5 assumed (the trial's Ke*I0 implied ~1.8 W)
assumptions.charger: Victron SmartSolar MPPT 100/15 (buck): starts when V_pv >= V_bat + 5 V, runs while V_pv >= V_bat + 1 V; 100 V max input
assumptions.current_limit_note: target generator-side limit (thermal); implemented only as the Victron battery-side charge-current limit below
assumptions.batt_limit_note: Victron charge-current limit: I_gen <= I_batt_lim * V_bat / (eta * V_dc); equals 1.2 A only at V_dc >= 29 V
assumptions.dump_resistor: Ohmite HS100 22R J (100 W) on a submerged 6061 plate (potted terminals): compromise between tip cavitation (sigma 1.09 at 3 m/s) and winding copper loss (20 W at 3 m/s)
assumptions.drum_note: rotating drum wetted length (tube + cap flanges) for the windage estimate
assumptions.dump_note: engage above the 2.2 m/s open-circuit voltage band is impossible (60 V), so engage 45 V catches >= ~1.7 m/s; release 12 V sits below every dump-equilibrium bus so the relay does not cycle
